prompt: Single game hero sprite: A proud, powerful, mature male axe-warrior of the Crescent Crane order, drawn as a chunky heroic cartoon character about 3 heads tall: a BIG head about one third of the whole figure height, a massive barrel chest, huge round shoulders, enormous forearms and ENORMOUS fists (each fist almost as big as his face), short thick legs and big heavy boots, a wide planted stance, never cute, never a mascot. His face is a big simple expressive face built from bold shapes: thick angular dark brows, wide white eye shapes with a dark dot, a big nose shape, a square jaw, a firm mouth line, and a short beard drawn as ONE solid dark shape with a lighter highlight patch; black hair tied in a high topknot with a vermilion cord, drawn as a few big solid clumps. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. SIGNATURE: behind his shoulder on the RIGHT side of the image rises ONE giant crane-wing shoulder guard, a fan of five overlapping ivory-white feather plates with a gold edge, as tall as his whole head, fixed to his armour; his shoulder on the LEFT side of the image has a smaller round indigo plate with a gold edge. His cuirass is chunky deep indigo plate with ONE simple gold crane emblem on the chest, ivory edge plates, a wide dark belt with a gold buckle and a hanging vermilion sash, and short coat tails of indigo cloth with an ivory lining and a few big torn pointed tips; a big gauntlet with a gold crescent plate on EACH forearm (identical on both arms), and a thick greave and a big round boot with a slightly upturned toe on EACH leg (identical). In the hand on the LEFT side of the image (his own right hand) he holds ONE oversized long-hafted crescent-moon axe: a dark haft with two ivory bands, a gold collar and a vermilion tassel under the blade, and at the top ONE huge chunky crescent-moon blade of dark steel, bigger than his torso, with a thick bright silver edge shape, its inner arc cut away as an open crescent, and ONE red gem at the socket; held by a huge clearly visible gripping fist; the hand on the RIGHT side of the image is empty, a huge clenched fist the same size as the axe hand. Main colour deep saturated indigo, second colour ivory white with gold, ONE bright accent vermilion red (sash, cord, tassel, gem); skin in warm tan. NEAR-FRONT VIEW from a high top-down camera: the body faces the viewer and is turned only about 20 degrees toward the RIGHT of the image, the face looking slightly right, the whole chest visible. BOTH ARMS are fully visible and the same size, neither hidden; BOTH LEGS are fully visible, the same size, neither hidden. Not a flat profile, not a straight front view. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm, strong idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning, both feet planted wide apart, side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, the right arm hanging down at his side away from the body; the axe stands upright beside his left hand with the butt of the haft on the ground line, the haft vertical and the crescent blade at the top, the whole axe clear of the legs and fully inside the frame with the top of the blade at least 10% below the top edge. Full body, centered, filling about 68% of the frame height. At most four colour families. Everything stays inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky heroic cartoon hero illustration, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Chunky rounded bean-like volumes with slight squash and stretch, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, exaggerated proportions with the hands, shoulders and the weapon enlarged and the legs shrunk. Colour: flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones (a shadow tone shifted toward a cooler hue, the base, a lighter tone, and one bright highlight shape on top), plus a few small flat mottled spot shapes on large surfaces; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark-brown outlines (dark indigo on the cool parts), thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner for inner lines, with rounded joins. Medium detail only: details are bold simple shapes (one emblem, layered plates, a tassel, a gem), no fine engraving, no filigree, no tiny patterns. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
